plan.description: Load the single-cell RNA-seq dataset using Scanpy. In this step, the raw .h5ad file containing gene expression profiles and malignancy annotations will be read and basic quality control (filtering, normalization) will be applied to prepare the data for downstream analysis.
input_filename: /cs/student/projects2/aisd/2024/shekchu/projects/cell_agents/biomaster/output/o3_full_dataset/annotated_cells_fixed_obs_names.h5ad: A single-cell RNA-seq breast cancer dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes, gene names, and malignancy classifications.
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_definition/preprocessed_annotated_cells.h5ad: Preprocessed single-cell dataset after quality control and normalization

plan.description: Subset the dataset to retain only the malignant cells. This filtering focuses the analysis on cells marked as malignant, which will then be classified into dormancy states.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_definition/preprocessed_annotated_cells.h5ad: Preprocessed single-cell dataset after quality control and normalization

plan.description: Compute cell cycle scores for the malignant cells using established cell cycle gene sets (e.g., G1/S and G2/M markers). This scoring will provide quantitative measurements that reflect proliferative activity, which is critical for classifying the cells as Dormant, Slow-cycling, or Proliferating.
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_definition/malignant_cells_cell_cycle_scores.h5ad: Malignant cells dataset updated with computed cell cycle scores

plan.description: Classify malignant cells based on the computed cell cycle scores and expression of cell cycle genes. Apply thresholds: assign cells with very low scores to 'Dormant', cells with intermediate scores to 'Slow-cycling', and those with high scores to 'Proliferating'. This classification is based on biological definitions where dormant cells are quiescent, slow-cycling cells show reduced proliferation, and proliferating cells are actively dividing.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_definition/malignant_cells_cell_cycle_scores.h5ad: Malignant cells dataset with cell cycle scores
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_definition/classified_malignant_cells.h5ad: Malignant cells classified into Dormant, Slow-cycling, and Proliferating groups

plan.description: Generate summary reports and visualizations such as UMAP plots and violin plots to illustrate the cell cycle scores and classification results. These visual outputs will support the interpretation of the classification, providing a comprehensive overview of the distribution of dormancy and proliferative states within the malignant cell population.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_definition/classified_malignant_cells.h5ad: Malignant cells classified into Dormant, Slow-cycling, and Proliferating groups
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy_with_definition/classification_report.pdf: PDF report summarizing the cell cycle based classification of malignant cells
